notes.generic: 199 actual reading C/assembly commands + CPP for the generic linker input; aggregate counts exactly reproduce the archived generic evidence.
notes.board: Only two additional C preprocessing units. The ST .s uses -x assembler, no CPP. The board ST .ld is passed directly to the linker; not run in C2. No board inputs copied.
notes.template: tx_user_sample.h alone, -x c with demo_threadx.c flags; not a board or Demo include. No internal TX_* switches invented.
notes.comparison: Each probe stripped of markers matched plain GCC -E -P. Each derived input matched baseline GCC -E -P -dD, discarding only all-whitespace lines; -H confirmed where all project headers came from.
notes.locations: The four exception sites use local #line N (no absolute path). For derived builds replace -I ${REPO}/main with -I ${REPO}/threadx_core, change source root, and pass -fmacro-prefix-map=<absolute threadx_core>=<absolute main> using actual driver path spelling. Preserve this flag in C3.
notes.votes: Within each arm votes=[[reached,selected] for generic, board, template], counting inclusion occurrences, not execution. An untaken outer arm accounts for unreachable descendants. #else and the frozen header are excluded from the 935 tests.
